message: My loved one has now been moved to where he will serve the rest of his time.  His calls are now long distance.  The calls are still through T-Netix, who is charging something like $2.85 for the connection and then $.30 per minute after that.  I've only taken two calls so far.  I have not been contacted by T-Netix yet.  We shall see what happens when my phone use reaches that seemingly critical $50.00 limit.  Will they block me then, even though my Verizon and AT&T bills are paid up?   I'll keep in touch.  Best wishes to everyone.
